name: obsidian-canvas-sync
description: Hybrid Canvas LMS integration for Obsidian: direct REST API syncing and zero-token browser session scraper
author: Joshua A. Wortz <security@codeandcypher.com> (https://github.com/SixFiveMil)

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/obsidian-plugin && npm run build -w apps/browser-extension && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('apps/obsidian-plugin/main.js', 'main.js'); if (require('fs').existsSync('apps/obsidian-plugin/styles.css')) require('fs').copyFileSync('apps/obsidian-plugin/styles.css', 'styles.css')"
scripts.build:plugin: npm run build -w apps/obsidian-plugin && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('apps/obsidian-plugin/main.js', 'main.js'); if (require('fs').existsSync('apps/obsidian-plugin/styles.css')) require('fs').copyFileSync('apps/obsidian-plugin/styles.css', 'styles.css')"
